#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Imports and experimental data"
from pathlib import Path
from functools import lru_cache
import contextlib
import io
import sys

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from numpy.polynomial.legendre import leggauss
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.special import j1, gammaincinv, gammaln
from IPython.display import display, Markdown

ROOT = next(p for p in (Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents)
            if (p / "docs/tutorials/data/f127/F127_0_merged_1.txt").is_file())
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
import pyseb

raw = np.loadtxt(ROOT / "docs/tutorials/data/f127/F127_0_merged_1.txt")
selected = raw[21:-2]
split = np.flatnonzero(np.diff(selected[:, 0]) < 0) + 1
assert len(split) == 1
q, intensity, sigma = selected[int(split[0]):].T
assert np.all(sigma > 0) and np.all(np.diff(q) > 0)

SCENE_DIR = ROOT / "docs/tutorials/generated/f127-corona"
SCENE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def scene_link(path, text):
    relative = path.relative_to(ROOT / "docs/tutorials").as_posix()
    display(Markdown(f"[{text}]({relative})"))
